extracted.intended_audience: researchers, scientists and other applicants looking for Wellcome funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance page describing Wellcome's funding schemes, the types of activity they support, where to find scheme deadlines and application systems, and pointers to topical guidance (eg COVID-19, career-stage support). Intended to help prospective applicants and current grantholders navigate opportunities and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding scheme change and timelines
rubrics_metrics.description: The way we fund research is changing to support our new strategy. A simplified set of funding schemes will be open for applications in summer 2021. Our current funding schemes will close during 2021. Most will be open for one or two more application rounds, depending on the scheme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should check the relevant scheme pages for application deadlines and be aware that schemes are closing or transitioning in 2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of activities supported
rubrics_metrics.description: Our schemes support individuals, teams, resources, seed ideas, places and major initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When considering applying, match your proposed activity to one of these supported types (e.g., individual fellowship vs team grant vs resource funding).

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic funding areas
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding is available in these areas: biomedical science; population health; product development and applied research; humanities and social science; public engagement and creative industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose scheme(s) aligned to the listed areas; consult specific scheme pages for fit and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application and grant management system
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for a grant or manage an existing one through our online system: Grant Tracker. Log in to Grant Tracker.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submissions and administration are handled via Grant Tracker — prospective applicants should ensure they can access and use the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to get funding guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: View funding guidance if you need help or advice with: looking for funding; a funding application; an existing Wellcome grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance covers searching for opportunities, preparing applications, and managing awarded grants; consult these resources before applying.

rubrics_metrics.name: COVID-19 (Coronavirus) guidance for applicants and grantholders
rubrics_metrics.description: Coronavirus (Covid-19) — What you need to know if you're a grant applicant or grantholder.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are specific notices or adjustments related to COVID-19 that applicants and grant holders should review; follow the linked guidance for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career-stage support
rubrics_metrics.description: See what we offer at key career stages and how we support research careers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wellcome provides targeted opportunities and support depending on career stage; prospective applicants should review offerings relevant to their stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency on funded people and projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Find out about the people and projects we've funded, including grants awarded, researcher stories and grant funding data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the funded projects and people pages to research past awards and examples of successful funding to inform applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay informed via newsletter
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign up to our research newsletter to stay up to date with funding news, policy changes and events with our bimonthly email.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribing helps applicants keep informed about scheme changes, deadlines, and policy updates.
